text:
hana: tiny QoS ask: can we add an export-level field `estimated_download_cost` that multiplies estimated_size_bytes by an egress rate? Compliance wants a quick dollars estimate before they approve large pulls.
olivia: Interesting. We bill egress differently per region; prefer exposing a pluggable estimator on the API side so console shows a per-tenant currency estimate. Defaults: cost_per_gb=0.12 USD but tenant can override via billing profile.
sachin: Implementation: when preview is requested, compute estimated_size_bytes from hourly counts, then call cost-estimator service to compute estimated_download_cost. Cache result 1h. Do not block export creation.
kevin: UX: show cost next to size estimate in preview modal and in table (muted). Add a toggle for "include_sparkline" in preview modal.
ingress-bot: Added ingress rule TODO for staged uploads: allow s3-presigned from build-job IPs.
hana: Also idea: for very large exports, show a recommended alternative: a filtered export (reduce date range) or a streaming webhook consumer. Could suggest filters automatically based on heavy tenants' top resource types.
olivia: Good. I'll add a flag in export metadata `recommended_filter_suggestion` containing array of suggestions (small strings). We'll need UX copywriting.
sachin: Telemetry: audit.export.preview_cost_shown, audit.export.preview_accepted. For staged jobs emit audit.export.staged_ready_notification_sent if user opted in.
hana: OK will demo in Friday's sync.
